meta.description: Candidate landing/hub pages for the page-forge automation (System 03 of the Cambo Autopilot plan) to build. Populated by the weekly metrics review (System 02's metrics-review.yml), the state-page expander, or added by hand. Not yet consumed by anything — System 03 (page forge) doesn't exist yet — see wiki 'Automation Plan — Cambo Autopilot'.

entryShape.vertical: e.g. 'exam-prep', 'compliance-training', 'publisher-answers', 'state-real-estate' — used to decide riskClass defaults and which existing pages to diff against for duplicate risk
entryShape.sourceUrl: the exam/course/certifying body's own page — page forge researches against this, not memory
entryShape.riskClass: 'low' (proven vertical + template, can auto-merge once guardrails pass) or 'high' (new vertical, publisher, school hub — always waits for review, see .github/workflows/guard.yml)
entryShape.addedAt: ISO date this entry was queued
entryShape.reason: why this topic — e.g. 'sibling of a top-converting entry page' or 'closes a gap identified in the SEO doc'
